build.script:
xcodebuild \
  -project USBProber.xcodeproj \
  -scheme 'USB Prober' \
  -configuration Development \
  -destination 'platform=macOS' \
  -derivedDataPath build/macos15 \
  build

clean.script:
xcodebuild \
  -project USBProber.xcodeproj \
  -scheme 'USB Prober' \
  -configuration Development \
  -destination 'platform=macOS' \
  -derivedDataPath build/macos15 \
  clean

run.script:
xcodebuild \
  -project USBProber.xcodeproj \
  -scheme 'USB Prober' \
  -configuration Development \
  -destination 'platform=macOS' \
  -derivedDataPath build/macos15 \
  build \
&& open "build/macos15/Build/Products/Development/USB Prober.app"
